lines.zh: 我贴着水底的沙走，影子比身子长。
lines.en: I skim the sandy bottom, my shadow longer than my body.

lines.zh: 任意一片水域都是我的路，我不挑。
lines.en: Any stretch of water counts as my road; I am not picky.

lines.zh: 一群最多六条，我游在最后。
lines.en: Six of us at most, and I swim at the back.

lines.zh: 我从荷叶底下钻过去，叶子晃了一下。
lines.en: I slip under a lily pad and it sways once.

lines.zh: 水草擦过我的鳍，我没停。
lines.en: Weeds brush my fins and I do not stop.

lines.zh: 河底的石头我认得，转弯不用看。
lines.en: I know the river stones; I turn without looking.

lines.zh: 我沿着岸边浅水走，躲开大鱼。
lines.en: I keep to the shallows by the bank, away from big fish.

lines.zh: 往上浮一寸，再往下沉两寸。
lines.en: I rise an inch and sink back two.

lines.zh: 湖心的水冷，我绕着它走一圈。
lines.en: The lake centre is cold, so I circle around it.

lines.zh: 我游过你脚边，你大概没察觉。
lines.en: I swim past your feet; you probably never noticed.

lines.zh: 下雨时水面乱，我照样走得稳。
lines.en: Rain roughens the surface; my path stays steady.

lines.zh: 我跟着水流走，逆流太费力气。
lines.en: I follow the current; upstream costs too much strength.

lines.zh: 我在水里从不停，停了就漂走。
lines.en: I never stop in water; stopping means drifting off.

lines.zh: 我拐进石缝，只留一截尾在外面。
lines.en: I turn into a rock crevice, one tail-fin left outside.

lines.zh: 我把嘴贴近水底，翻起一点沙。
lines.en: I put my mouth to the bottom and puff up a little sand.

lines.zh: 身后的水草被我带得歪了。
lines.en: The weeds behind me bend as I pass.

lines.zh: 水面上的叶子转了个方向。
lines.en: A leaf on the surface turns the other way.

lines.zh: 我钻进桥墩的影子里缓一缓。
lines.en: I slip into the shade of a bridge post to rest.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，鳃一开一合。
lines.en: I hang in the water, gills opening and closing.

lines.zh: 水底的沙慢慢落到我背上。
lines.en: Sand from the bottom settles slowly onto my back.

lines.zh: 我数着经过的鱼，数到第五条就乱了。
lines.en: I count passing fish and lose it at the fifth.

lines.zh: 三条命值不了什么，我清楚。
lines.en: Three hearts are not worth much; I know that.

lines.zh: 有片叶子飘下来，我退开半寸。
lines.en: A leaf drifts down and I back off half an inch.

lines.zh: 我吐出两个泡，第二个破在半路。
lines.en: I blow two bubbles; the second bursts halfway up.

lines.zh: 水草在我旁边摇，我什么都不做。
lines.en: The weeds sway beside me and I do nothing.

lines.zh: 我在水底找吃的，多半找不到。
lines.en: I forage along the bottom and mostly find nothing.

lines.zh: 光从水面碎下来，落在我身上。
lines.en: Light breaks through the surface and lands on me.

lines.zh: 我听着水上的响动，不动。
lines.en: I listen to the noise above the water and stay still.

lines.zh: 这条河我住了很久，还没逛完。
lines.en: I have lived in this river long and still not seen it all.

lines.zh: 我的鳍一下一下，像在数拍子。
lines.en: My fins beat softly, as if keeping time.

lines.zh: 水变浑了，我更喜欢这样。
lines.en: The water turns murky, which suits me better.

lines.zh: 我在等一条虫子掉下来。
lines.en: I am waiting for a worm to fall in.

lines.zh: 我停在你的影子下面，抬头看。
lines.en: I stop beneath your shadow and look up.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，水面上全是你的形状。
lines.en: You stand on the bank; the surface is all your shape.

lines.zh: 我认得你的靴子，上次也在。
lines.en: I recognise your boots; they were here last time too.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，除非你手里有竿。
lines.en: I am not afraid of you, unless you hold a rod.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在两侧，能看见你两边。
lines.en: My eyes sit on both sides and see either side of you.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我往深处退了退。
lines.en: You crouch down and I back a little deeper.

lines.zh: 我在水里看你，你在岸上看水。
lines.en: I watch you from the water; you watch the water.

lines.zh: 你的倒影晃了一下，我的尾巴也晃。
lines.en: Your reflection wavers and my tail wavers back.

lines.zh: 我见过很多人，你是安静的一个。
lines.en: I have seen many people; you are a quiet one.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我滑得抓不住。
lines.en: Do not reach in; I am too slippery to hold.

lines.zh: 我的鳞翻开一片，水渗进去。
lines.en: A scale peels back and water seeps in.

lines.zh: 这一下打掉我一条命的份量。
lines.en: That blow costs me a third of my life.

lines.zh: 我甩尾巴往石缝里钻。
lines.en: I flick my tail and dive into the crevice.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，很快就淡了。
lines.en: My blood spreads in the water and fades fast.

lines.zh: 我疼得翻了个身，又正过来。
lines.en: Pain rolls me over, and I right myself.

lines.zh: 你打偏了，只擦到我的背鳍。
lines.en: You missed and only clipped my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 我往深处沉，越深越安全。
lines.en: I sink deeper, where it is safer.

lines.zh: 别打了，我掉的东西不值钱。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; what I drop is worth little.

lines.zh: 我贴着泥不动，装成一块石头。
lines.en: I press into the mud and play dead stone.

lines.zh: 三条命眨眼就剩两条了。
lines.en: Three hearts become two in a blink.

lines.zh: 那是什么味道，水都变甜了。
lines.en: What is that smell? The water tastes sweeter.

lines.zh: 你要是撒面包屑，我就敢靠近。
lines.en: Drop breadcrumbs and I will dare come closer.

lines.zh: 我盯着水面那点碎屑，绕了两圈。
lines.en: I stare at the crumbs on the surface and circle twice.

lines.zh: 味道是从你手那边来的，我闻得到。
lines.en: The smell comes from your hand; I can taste it.

lines.zh: 我往前一尺，又退回半尺。
lines.en: I advance a foot and retreat half of one.

lines.zh: 虫子落水的声音，我永远不会错过。
lines.en: I never miss the sound of an insect hitting water.

lines.zh: 我饿了一整天，这点就够了。
lines.en: I have been hungry all day; this is enough.

lines.zh: 你晃一晃手里的东西，我尾巴就快了。
lines.en: Wiggle what you hold and my tail speeds up.

lines.zh: 我只想要一口，你偏不松手。
lines.en: I only want one bite and you will not let go.

lines.zh: 那条虫子太近岸，我不敢上去。
lines.en: That worm is too close to the bank for me.

lines.zh: 我撞到你的腿，像撞上一堵热墙。
lines.en: I bump your leg, like hitting a warm wall.

lines.zh: 我游得太急，鼻子先碰了你。
lines.en: I swim too fast and my snout hits you first.

lines.zh: 你动了一下，水面把我推回去。
lines.en: You move and the water shoves me back.

lines.zh: 是我没让路，我认。
lines.en: I did not give way, and I admit it.

lines.zh: 碰到你的靴子，我掉头就跑。
lines.en: I touch your boot, then turn and flee.

lines.zh: 一群鱼挤在一起，我被顶了出去。
lines.en: The school presses together and I get shoved out.

lines.zh: 我贴着你绕过去，鳞片蹭到布料。
lines.en: I squeeze past you, scales scraping the cloth.

lines.zh: 水下什么都看不清，撞上很正常。
lines.en: Nothing is clear underwater; collisions are normal.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，这次我算好了角度。
lines.en: One more bump, and this time I chose the angle.

lines.zh: 别踩下来，我就在你脚边。
lines.en: Do not step down; I am right by your feet.

lines.zh: 春天水暖，我身上的颜色深一层。
lines.en: Spring warms the water and my colours deepen.

lines.zh: 我在石缝里清出一块地方。
lines.en: I clear a patch of gravel in a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 她游过来，我把鳍张开给她看。
lines.en: She swims near and I spread my fins for her.

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一块石头转圈。
lines.en: We circle the same stone, over and over.

lines.zh: 水底的沙被我们扇起来，很浑。
lines.en: Our tails stir the sand until the water clouds.

lines.zh: 卵落在石缝里，我不再管别的。
lines.en: Eggs fall into the crevice; nothing else matters.

lines.zh: 守着这片浅水，我谁都不让。
lines.en: I guard this patch of shallows and let nobody in.

lines.zh: 她的尾巴扫过我，我知道成了。
lines.en: Her tail brushes mine; I know it is done.

lines.zh: 六条里只有我们两个留在这里。
lines.en: Only the two of us remain out of the six.

lines.zh: 等卵孵出来，这片水就挤了。
lines.en: Once the eggs hatch, this water will be crowded.

lines.zh: 你把我捧起来，我甩了一身水。
lines.en: You scoop me up and I splash water everywhere.

lines.zh: 你的手太干，我身上黏。
lines.en: Your hands are dry; my skin is slick.

lines.zh: 装进桶里，我撞了三下桶壁。
lines.en: Dropped in a bucket, I hit the side three times.

lines.zh: 我离了水，鳃还在一张一合。
lines.en: Out of water, my gills still open and close.

lines.zh: 别捏太紧，我只有三条命的份量。
lines.en: Do not squeeze; I weigh no more than three hearts.

lines.zh: 桶里的水晃，我跟着晃。
lines.en: The bucket water sways and I sway with it.

lines.zh: 你提着我走，我看见岸越来越高。
lines.en: You carry me off and the bank grows taller.

lines.zh: 我落回水里，第一件事是逃。
lines.en: Back in the water, the first thing I do is flee.

lines.zh: 手掌的热透过鳞片，很不舒服。
lines.en: The heat of your palm seeps through my scales.

lines.zh: 下次用网，别用这只手。
lines.en: Use a net next time, not that hand.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，我立刻转头。
lines.en: You step into the water and I turn at once.

lines.zh: 水纹一变，我就知道有东西在动。
lines.en: The ripples change and I know something moves.

lines.zh: 你在浅水里站着，我盯着你的脚。
lines.en: You stand in the shallows; I fix on your feet.

lines.zh: 我围着那片水转了半圈，看清了。
lines.en: I circle that patch half a turn and see it clearly.

lines.zh: 有东西在踩我的石缝，我记住了。
lines.en: Something treads on my crevice; I remember it.

lines.zh: 我身体一沉，那是准备动的意思。
lines.en: I sink lower, which means I am about to move.

lines.zh: 我不冲上去，我先看清你多高。
lines.en: I do not charge; first I measure how tall you are.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住水底，我抬了头。
lines.en: Your shadow covers the bottom and I look up.

lines.zh: 被我记住的东西，一般走不掉。
lines.en: What I take note of seldom gets away.

lines.zh: 别在水里挥手，那像在招惹我。
lines.en: Do not wave in the water; it looks like a challenge.

lines.zh: 我每一次绕行，都比上次近一点。
lines.en: Each pass around you comes a little nearer.

lines.zh: 我的鳍不动了，只用尾巴掌方向。
lines.en: My fins hold still; the tail steers.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，等你停下。
lines.en: I count your steps and wait for you to stop.

lines.zh: 你在水里转身慢，我看得出来。
lines.en: You turn slowly in water; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我一直保持半臂的距离。
lines.en: I keep half an arm's length between us.

lines.zh: 水面上的光挡了我一下，我换角度。
lines.en: Surface glare blinds me; I shift my angle.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了就没用了。
lines.en: I stay silent; noise would ruin it.

lines.zh: 你的靴子陷在淤泥里，你走不快。
lines.en: Your boots are in the silt; I know you are slow.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底靠近，泥挡住了我。
lines.en: I creep along the bottom, mud hiding me.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我就要动了。
lines.en: One step closer and I will move.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口你的脚踝，没什么力道。
lines.en: I bite your ankle, and it carries no weight.

lines.zh: 我只咬到靴子，牙都钝了。
lines.en: I only bite the boot, and blunt my teeth.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，比咬更有效。
lines.en: A body-check works better than a bite.

lines.zh: 我的嘴小，只够夹住你的手指。
lines.en: My mouth is small, only enough to pinch a finger.

lines.zh: 我咬完就退，从不缠斗。
lines.en: I bite and retreat; I never grapple.

lines.zh: 你抬脚，我被水推得翻了个身。
lines.en: You lift your foot and the water rolls me over.

lines.zh: 这三条命的鱼也敢咬人。
lines.en: Even a three-heart fish will bite a person.

lines.zh: 牙齿划过鳞片的声音很难听。
lines.en: Teeth scraping scales make an ugly sound.

lines.zh: 我咬住水草，咬错了。
lines.en: I bite the weeds; I picked wrong.

lines.zh: 你要是流血，水会告诉我。
lines.en: If you bleed, the water will tell me.

lines.zh: 我从卵里出来时，只有一粒沙大。
lines.en: When I hatched I was no bigger than a grain of sand.

lines.zh: 这片水没有名字，我照样出生。
lines.en: This water has no name, and I am born in it.

lines.zh: 我们一群六条，一起落到水底。
lines.en: Six of us drop to the bottom together.

lines.zh: 二十的权重，让我到处都是。
lines.en: Weight twenty makes me everywhere at once.

lines.zh: 我睁眼第一件事是找水草。
lines.en: The first thing I look for is the weeds.

lines.zh: 水很凉，我抖了一下才开始游。
lines.en: The water is cold; I shiver before swimming.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己为什么在这里。
lines.en: I do not know why I am here.

lines.zh: 湖边、河里、池塘，随便哪一处。
lines.en: Lakeside, river, pond, any of them will do.

lines.zh: 我生下来就会游，没学过。
lines.en: I could swim at birth; nobody taught me.

lines.zh: 三条命，够我开始这一段了。
lines.en: Three hearts are enough to start this life.

lines.zh: 水面被火烤热，我往深处躲。
lines.en: Fire heats the surface and I dive for depth.

lines.zh: 我被甩出水面，摔在石头上弹了一下。
lines.en: Flung from the water, I bounce once on stone.

lines.zh: 在水里我也会闷，鳃被泥堵了。
lines.en: Even in water I suffocate when mud clogs my gills.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水掀开，我被冲得打转。
lines.en: The blast lifts the water and spins me around.

lines.zh: 箭从水面穿下来，钉进我旁边的泥。
lines.en: An arrow spears down and pins the mud beside me.

lines.zh: 魔法的光让我的鳞片发麻。
lines.en: Magic light makes my scales go numb.

lines.zh: 饿到第三天，水草也算一顿。
lines.en: By the third day, weeds count as a meal.

lines.zh: 雷落进水里，我浑身一震。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and jolts through me.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我的鳃空张着。
lines.en: The void has no water; my gills open on nothing.
